umbrella.title: Research roadmap: trained use cases, verifiable edits, and weight-space capability tests
umbrella.body:
The next milestone is a trained customer-support router: change ownership or repair a learned confusion while preserving other behavior, and compare weight editing with rules, an unchanged intent-to-queue overlay, and retraining. The existing outage demo is synthetic teaching evidence. The framework remains generic; a second trained non-text task follows the first study.

Research review: **November 8, 2026**. [Read the full roadmap](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) and [primary-source review](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json). All listed work is proposed. Opening issues is administrative tracking, not scientific progress or measured business impact.

## Execution gates

1. **Credible experiment:** bind candidates/contracts, declare numerical scope, freeze useful gain/harm/coverage/cost margins and untouched units, and prepare the trained routing pilot.
2. **Useful trained editing:** compare overlays/retraining; test feasibility, unseen behavior, abstention and full cost. Favor a simpler overlay where it solves the case more cheaply.
3. **Live understanding and sequences:** run access ablations with actual provider provenance, validate blinded diagnoses through interventions, and enforce cumulative original-baseline/old-target contracts.
4. **Broader framework evidence:** add a trained non-text task, candidate-specific Lean instances, and bottleneck-driven semantic/cost extensions.
5. **Gated research:** test compatible-family transfer, restricted no-fitting construction and bounded synthetic unlearning. Reconsider recursive self-improvement only after live, causal and cumulative-retention evidence.

These are dependencies of claims. Honest empirical work need not wait for every formal proof. Real-valued certificates, native measurements, editor ability and task utility remain separate evidence lanes.

## Work issues

- [ ] #3 — [P0] Bind admission to the exact candidate, contract, domain, and decision rule
- [ ] #12 — [P0] Generate and independently validate Lean instances for new runtime candidates
- [ ] #4 — [P0] Extend native-execution accounting to operation order and decision boundaries
- [ ] #5 — [P0] Build brokered editor access with opaque submissions and provider provenance
- [ ] #2 — [P0] Freeze independent task protocols, useful-effect margins, and full attempt accounting
- [ ] #7 — [P1] Run a trained support-routing policy change against overlays and retraining
- [ ] #6 — [P1] Measure protected feature coverage, nullspace feasibility, and abstention
- [ ] #8 — [P1] Test what a live proposer gains from weights at matched semantic context
- [ ] #9 — [P1] Validate blind weight-space diagnoses through controlled repair interventions
- [ ] #10 — [P1] Admit cumulative edit lineages against the original baseline and earlier targets
- [ ] #11 — [P2] Validate the shared framework on a second trained non-text task
- [ ] #13 — [P2] Extend supported semantics and tighten bounds where trained cases are blocked
- [ ] #14 — [P2] Measure end-to-end edit cost and optimize only the observed bottlenecks
- [ ] #15 — [P2] Independently repeat a selected original-source task with explicit reproduction tiers
- [ ] #16 — [P2 research] Test symmetry-aware edit transfer before cross-architecture circuit grafting
- [ ] #17 — [P2 research] Separate no-fitting construction and zero-data steering from fitted editing
- [ ] #18 — [P2 gated research] Evaluate synthetic unlearning against extraction and recovery attacks

## Completion criteria for this tracker

- [ ] Each work issue has an owner-independent deliverable, explicit prerequisites and falsification criteria, and leaves replayable artifacts or a documented negative result.
- [ ] The first trained study has a protocol frozen before untouched evaluation, complete attempt/missingness records, and meaningful utility/retention/coverage/cost comparisons.
- [ ] Every stronger claim names the data, model lineage, access, semantic and numerical scope; unsupported claims remain open or explicitly rejected.
- [ ] Original future directions and all eleven existing limitation packages are covered; historical sources/results and requirement statuses are not rewritten as completed by this plan.

No calendar completion date or production advantage is assumed. Full-rank protection, failed generalization, no useful weight-access effect, and a better low-cost overlay are legitimate stopping results.

work.title: [P0] Bind admission to the exact candidate, contract, domain, and decision rule
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P0**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

A sound check can refer to the wrong endpoint, feature ordering, domain, or semantic adapter, making an admitted artifact unsafe for the declared request.

- [rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py): Candidate and workflow receipts already record identities.
- [rlcd/weight_space/contracts.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/contracts.py): The older Contract path and argmax check are distinct from generic workflow admission.
- [rlcd/weight_space/features.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/features.py): Retention receipts exist; their scope must be bound to the same integrated admission record.

## Hypothesis and scope

One immutable admission record can connect structural, semantic, numerical and behavioral evidence without conflating their claims.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Define a versioned record binding parent/candidate bytes, task, feature/bias conventions, adapter/version, input domain, outputs, structural constraints, score budgets and decision semantics.
- [ ] Make every gate identify that record and retain its own result: invalid, unsupported, missing correspondence, conservative rejection, observed violation or pass.
- [ ] Implement independent record replay and explicit unique-argmax, tie and nonfinite handling; unsupported stochastic semantics must be visible.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Deliberate endpoint, domain, adapter/version, coordinate-order, witness and decision-rule substitutions are rejected.
- [ ] Independent recomputation reproduces every admission result on frozen records, including no-op, invalid and unsupported cases.
- [ ] Any accepted identity mismatch falsifies the binding claim; conservative rejection is reported as coverage loss rather than a counterexample.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: None; can start independently. Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S12 TorchLean scope/trust boundaries
- Existing limitation package 1; R05/R07/R27/R29/R32/R40

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

## Claim this can unlock

Every gate in an integrated decision concerns the same immutable artifact and declared claim.

Binding does not prove the extractor, backend arithmetic or useful business behavior. Keep those evidence lanes distinct.

work.title: [P0] Generate and independently validate Lean instances for new runtime candidates
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P0**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Checked hand-written coefficients do not automatically establish a theorem for the artifact produced at runtime.

- [formal/weight-space/README.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/formal/weight-space/README.md): Real-valued results and generic audit targets already exist; historical source-specific generation does not cover arbitrary supported runtime candidates.
- [docs/weight-space/v2/formal.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/formal.md): The runtime-to-proof correspondence gap is documented.

## Hypothesis and scope

A deliberately small exact serialization/generation bridge can attach a checked theorem instance to immutable endpoints and premises.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Start with the supported frozen linear head and a small sequential semantic subset; generate rational endpoint values, shapes, activations, feature/bias ordering, domain and exact theorem premises.
- [ ] Pin generator, generated source, Lean target/dependencies and logs; independently decode generated values and compare with original endpoints and artifact identities.
- [ ] Evaluate relevant TorchLean components for reuse and document the exact trust boundary; retain historical proof/source identities.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Deterministic regeneration yields identical definitions and a successful theorem application for supported zero and nonzero edits.
- [ ] Mutation tests reject wrong endpoints, shape/order/bias, feature identity, domain and unsupported activation cases.
- [ ] The certificate explicitly lists serialization/extractor/backend assumptions. A passing theorem for different decoded values falsifies the bridge claim.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #3 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S12 TorchLean
- Existing limitation package 2; R31/R34/R37–R39

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). ## Claim this can unlock

A new supported runtime candidate has a machine-checked real-valued theorem instance with independently validated endpoint mapping.

This does not prove arbitrary PyTorch export, GPU execution or learned-encoder domain coverage. Honest empirical studies can proceed before this package completes.

work.title: [P0] Extend native-execution accounting to operation order and decision boundaries
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P0**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

A near-zero real/anchor residual can coexist with a native decision change, especially under cancellation or a small winner margin.

- [rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py): The existing CPU precision ablation already measures native versus lifted behavior and changes the parent when projecting precision.
- [docs/weight-space/v2/results.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/results.md): Non-no-op numerical nullspace endpoints have nonzero exact residuals; tolerance passes are not exact zero.
- [rlcd/weight_space/structured.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/structured.py): Native realization receipts are available.

## Hypothesis and scope

Explicit arithmetic/backend scope plus measured or proved error accounting can connect a real-valued bound to the deployed decision rule.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Extend the existing study with accumulation order, cancellation, near-tie margins, nonfinite/overflow behavior, quantization and a pinned backend/version matrix where available; identify each projected parent baseline.
- [ ] Retain stored endpoints, exact-lifted outputs, native outputs and per-coordinate decision effects. Separate endpoint quantization from intermediate arithmetic.
- [ ] Provide an empirical lane first; add a formal lane only for a specified operation model with explicit rounding/domain premises and total decision-error budget.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Boundary and cancellation cases expose disagreement when present; no-op and baseline transforms are reported consistently.
- [ ] Any native decision-preservation claim accounts for arithmetic error and margin/tie semantics; a violated declared rule blocks that claim.
- [ ] Report backend/device/operator coverage and unsupported cases. Measurements on one backend do not become a universal numerical proof.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #3 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S12 TorchLean finite-path refinement and external hardware boundary
- S11 deployment-transform recovery (scope lesson)
- Existing limitation package 3; R24–R28/R39

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

Numerical measurements or bounds have a specified execution scope and can be interpreted alongside decision retention.

Do not duplicate a generic add-dtype-tests issue or equate exact rational lifting with the executed kernel.

work.title: [P0] Build brokered editor access with opaque submissions and provider provenance
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P0**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Cooperative callbacks in a shared process do not enforce no-forward/no-fitting access, and submission feedback can leak hidden exact weights.

- [rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py): ProgrammerSession enforces methods and charges; ReplayProvider is scripted, not a live provider experiment.
- [docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md): Outside computation and rounded-weight submission leaks are documented.

## Hypothesis and scope

A restricted proposer process and trusted broker can enforce specified I/O/tool restrictions and accurately disclose the remaining limits.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Separate proposer, trusted artifact/operation broker and sealed evaluator; use opaque candidate handles and scoped feedback for rounded/subset-weight conditions.
- [ ] Version exposed metadata, parameter views, tool/computation policy, resources, retries, proposal selection and failure accounting. Identify enforceable OS/container controls and residual trust.
- [ ] Implement a real provider adapter with exact provider/model/configuration identity, prompts, tool calls, token/latency/cost usage, errors and human involvement. Keep credential material out of records.
- [ ] Add leak/adversarial cases for hidden exact-parent extraction, private evaluator access, unauthorized network/files, reconstructed forward calls through allowed tools, and off-ledger attempts.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Denied broker operations fail and are recorded; sealed test data and hidden exact endpoints are not returned through supported submission/feedback routes.
- [ ] A live trial produces replayable public-safe provenance and complete attempted/completed/failed/abstained accounting.
- [ ] Claims distinguish brokered I/O restrictions from unverifiable semantic absence of computation. Exact weights plus unrestricted arithmetic cannot substantiate no-inference by callback counts alone.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #3 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S1 source access protocols
- Existing limitation package 4; R06/R09–R20/R46

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

## Claim this can unlock

Supported live trials expose an auditable, specifically restricted information/computation regime.

This is not proof that an adversarial model never internally simulates a network or performs prohibited external work. Do not claim hermetic enforcement without the implemented controls.

work.title: [P0] Freeze independent task protocols, useful-effect margins, and full attempt accounting
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P0**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Observed worlds and complete-case summaries cannot support fresh confirmation; large row counts obscure the actual independent units.

- [rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py): World-paired analysis and a local freeze already exist; current observed worlds and exploratory intervals remain historical.
- [rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py): Split identities and sealed evaluation provide bookkeeping, not semantic independence.
- [docs/weight-space/v2/requirements.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/requirements.md): Separate read/diagnose/edit/create requirements are recorded.

## Hypothesis and scope

A frozen claim-specific protocol can yield interpretable utility/retention/access evidence and preserve failures instead of selecting them away.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Define separate rubrics for reading, diagnosis, editing, creation and transfer. Specify allowed context/weights/examples/computation, independent units, training ancestry, candidate selection and primary comparisons.
- [ ] Freeze concrete minimum gain, maximum harm, minimum coverage and resource values before confirmation, using a separate pilot/stakeholder justification; plan sample size from effects/variance.
- [ ] Audit exact/near duplicates, task-family and lineage splits; retain all assigned attempts, no-ops, abstentions, rejected edits, failures/timeouts, missing reasons and sensitivity rules.
- [ ] Implement paired or appropriately hierarchical/crossed analysis, comparison-family/multiplicity rules, per-unit raw records and protocol/source/data hashes. Distinguish local freeze from external preregistration.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Future confirmation uses unseen units selected before outcomes; worlds 7300–7311 are labeled reproduction only.
- [ ] The denominator is all assigned trials, with joint useful success and conditional success/coverage reported together; informative missingness is not silently dropped.
- [ ] Retries/rows/architecture exports are not counted as independent editors/lineages. Synthetic evidence and ancestry limitations remain explicit.
- [ ] A holdout used to tune prompts, thresholds or edit selection is invalidated and becomes development data.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: None; can start independently. Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S5 Mirage/WILD
- S6 editing evaluation and contextual baseline
- S7 ForgetBench units
- S23 selective risk/coverage
- Existing limitation package 5; R03/R04/R08/R41–R54

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

## Claim this can unlock

A new experiment has meaningful frozen criteria, a justified population, and complete reproducible outcome accounting.

A public benchmark split cannot prove absence of pretraining exposure. No universal effect margin or arbitrary test count is imposed.

work.title: [P1] Run a trained support-routing policy change against overlays and retraining
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P1**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

The enterprise story uses synthetic structured inputs and a hand-constructed head; it does not show useful editing of a trained text router.

- [examples/enterprise_support_routing.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/examples/enterprise_support_routing.py): A synthetic outage flag makes selective repair unusually easy.
- [docs/use-cases/enterprise-support-routing.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/use-cases/enterprise-support-routing.md): The integration pattern is explicit about synthetic data and unmeasured operational impact.
- [rlcd/weight_space/compiler.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/compiler.py): Frozen-feature fitting and retention provide a controllable first editing route.
- [rlcd/weight_space/features.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/features.py): Generic frozen-feature editing, numerical nullspace proposals and exact endpoint retention receipts are implemented.

## Hypothesis and scope

A frozen text encoder with a trained head can expose where model editing adds value over policy configuration, and where it should abstain.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Pin BANKING77 data/revision/notices and encoder/model revision/license; train a reproducible head and disclose known pretraining ancestry. Freeze a derived intent-to-queue mapping and ownership-change cases.
- [ ] Evaluate both ownership-change cases and separately prespecified recognition-repair cases found only on development data; keep target, protected, calibration/selection and sealed test data distinct.
- [ ] Compare unchanged parent, rules/intent-to-queue overlay, task-compatible context method, target-only/soft/hard retained edits and tuned head retraining; include broader adaptation controls only with clearly separate scope/cost.
- [ ] Record rank/feasibility, realized score residuals, target/protected/per-intent queue outcomes, near-intent/OOD stress, abstention and total cost. Publish a replayable report with negative results.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] All primary gain/harm/coverage/cost margins and selection rules are frozen before unseen evaluation; paired units and missingness follow benchmark.
- [ ] A rule/overlay that matches outcomes more cheaply is recommended for that case. An edit advantage is claimed only where it clears the frozen criteria.
- [ ] Report dataset intent labels and project-derived queue policy separately; do not claim telemetry outages, measured transfers, resolution savings or live customer evidence.
- [ ] No manually inserted target-only feature establishes trained-representation generalization.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #2, #3, #4, #6 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S22 BANKING77
- S21 CLINC (follow-on OOD/cross-dataset extension)
- S6 non-weight baseline
- S20 adaptation baseline

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

## Claim this can unlock

Empirical value or failure of head weight editing for a specified trained public text-routing task relative to simpler alternatives.

Pilot preparation can start before dependencies finish. A positive result is not production impact or a live LLM/no-fitting claim; proof-bridge is required only for candidate-specific machine-checked claims.

work.title: [P1] Measure protected feature coverage, nullspace feasibility, and abstention
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P1**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Adding protection can remove every useful edit direction; small sampled residuals can also conceal large unseen drift.

- [rlcd/weight_space/features.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/features.py): Numerical projection and exact realized-endpoint receipts are implemented.
- [rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/study_v2.py): Anchor/precision ablations exist, but share observed worlds and use random extractors.
- [examples/enterprise_support_routing.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/examples/enterprise_support_routing.py): The dedicated outage coordinate and unseen intermittent-errors rejection show a feature-coverage boundary.

## Hypothesis and scope

Protected rank, target projected energy and decision margins predict whether selective edits can generalize at acceptable size/harm.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Measure augmented-feature rank/nullity, singular values, numerical cutoff, conditioning, target energy outside protected span and required edit norm; handle incompatible multi-target constraints.
- [ ] Compare exact-arithmetic feasibility, numerical hard projection, soft score budgets and margin/decision retention on trained features. Sweep thresholds on development data only.
- [ ] Evaluate residuals and nearby/unseen/OOD behavior away from anchors; quantify empirical uncovered components separately from whole-domain bounds.
- [ ] Expose explicit abstention/no-op reasons and risk/coverage or gain/harm/coverage frontiers.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Full row-rank protection permits only zero head edit under exact score retention; conflicting targets are detected and never reported as useful success.
- [ ] Nonzero exact endpoint residuals remain numeric values rather than an exact-zero claim, even if tolerance passes.
- [ ] The useful-success denominator includes every assigned case, and low harm at zero coverage is not an advantage.
- [ ] Any all-domain retention claim supplies the domain coverage/encoder premises; sampled coverage is labeled empirical.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #2, #3 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S2 AlphaEdit practical threshold
- S23 selective classification
- Existing limitation package 6; R27/R33–R35/R39/R47

[Detailed roadmap and trained-use-case protocol](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-roadmap-2026-11.md) · [Primary-source findings, reviewed scope and byte identities](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/research-sources-2026-11.json) · [Current limitation packages](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md). Source IDs refer to the roadmap's primary-source register.

## Claim this can unlock

A measured feasibility/coverage boundary and justified abstention policy for the declared feature map and task.

Feature count, anchor count and nullspace dimension alone are not behavioral coverage or useful utility.

work.title: [P1] Test what a live proposer gains from weights at matched semantic context
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P1**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

The framework has no live-provider evidence; rich task hints or fitting may explain apparent weight-space ability.

- [rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py): ReplayProvider exercises protocol routing without testing a live model.
- [docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md): Context, parameter views, examples, computation and task axes are already separated.

## Hypothesis and scope

A controlled access ablation can distinguish useful information in weights from supplied context, forward feedback and optimizer assistance.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Freeze read/diagnose/edit rubrics on untouched trained cases; compare identical context with no weights, summaries, rounded/subset values and exact values.
- [ ] Separate tool-free/no-forward, allowed-analysis, target-execution and fitting-permitted regimes. Include analytic, context-only and tuned optimizer controls compatible with each regime.
- [ ] Run actual independent provider trials with pinned configuration, access/budget ledgers, failure/abstention and human-assistance records; audit names/hints that reveal answers.
- [ ] Analyze paired task/checkpoint effects and editor variability; publish information actually exposed after submissions, not just nominal access labels.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] All compared arms receive matched semantic context and eligible evidence; work/feedback differences and costs are disclosed.
- [ ] A live-weight benefit claim clears the frozen primary effect/harm/coverage criteria beyond context-only/summaries; null results remain published.
- [ ] Provider requests/responses/usage exist and are replayable without credentials; replay scripts are never counted as independent live editors.
- [ ] A rounded/subset editing arm cannot retrieve exact hidden parent values via candidate feedback.

## Dependencies and research basis

Dependencies for the final claim: #5, #2, #7 Pilot/design work can proceed where independent; a dependency is not a blanket prohibition on honest empirical work.

- S1 author report/access protocols
- S6 contextual baseline
- S17 NFN and S18 DWS as architecture-aware reader alternatives

work.title: [P1] Validate blind weight-space diagnoses through controlled repair interventions
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P1**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Identifying a plausible coefficient or explaining a failure does not show that the proposed mechanism caused it or that repair preserves other behavior.

- [docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md): The deterministic sign fixture routes answers; it is not causal discovery.
- [rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/workflow.py): Separate diagnosis/answer and editing routes can retain frozen predictions.

## Hypothesis and scope

Blinded planted mechanisms and matched interventions can test whether weight access predicts causal repair beyond context and chance.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Construct fresh trained cases with evaluator-known injected mechanisms; hide injection identity, answer-bearing names and causal hints from proposers.
- [ ] Freeze location, mechanism, predicted effect, uncertainty and abstention before any evaluator-only intervention; separate diagnosis and repair selection.
- [ ] Compare sham, random, support/norm-matched and context-only controls, then measure target effect, collateral behavior and held-out generalization.
- [ ] Report localization, prediction calibration, intervention effect and useful retained repair as separate endpoints with lineage/editor nesting.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Predictions are sealed before interventions and untouched evaluation; successful localization without useful repair is not causal-repair success.
- [ ] The predicted intervention has a prespecified effect beyond matched controls while meeting retention criteria, or the causal hypothesis is rejected.
- [ ] Planted mechanisms are disclosed as controlled synthetic manipulations, and multiple seeds/rows from one mechanism do not establish natural backdoor detection.
- [ ] No-forward auditing refers to proposer access; later evaluator execution is explicitly recorded.

work.title: [P2 research] Test symmetry-aware edit transfer before cross-architecture circuit grafting
work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P2 research**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Equivalent trained networks may permute or scale hidden units, making raw coordinate edits meaningless; alignment alone does not establish causal correspondence.

- [rlcd/weight_space/symmetry.py](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/rlcd/weight_space/symmetry.py): Known ReLU gauge transport, heuristic hidden alignment and additive transfer already exist; alignment residuals are explicitly not certificates.
- [docs/weight-space/results.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/results.md): Historical controlled synthetic transfer results exist; independently trained held-out lineage and cross-architecture evidence remains unresolved.

## Hypothesis and scope

Known symmetry controls and aligned transfer can establish a narrow compatible-family result before any circuit-grafting claim.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Extend the existing ReLU gauge/heuristic transfer baseline to a frozen trained-lineage study. Declare valid symmetry groups for each supported activation/graph; retain known function-preserving permutation/scaling positive controls and unsupported-family checks.
- [ ] Compare raw transfer, symmetry-aligned transfer, no transfer, matched random edits and target fitting on held-out trained lineages/task variants.
- [ ] Evaluate relevant DeepAlign/NFN/DWS/ScaleGMN representations while charging reader/alignment training and access; retain parent correspondence and all selection.
- [ ] Require frozen functional/causal intervention criteria before labeling a transferred substructure a circuit; cross-architecture studies require a separate protocol.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] Positive same-function controls recover predictions before transfer; negative raw-coordinate controls expose parameterization sensitivity.
- [ ] Transfer gains and retention generalize to held-out training lineages at frozen criteria, or the hypothesis is rejected.
- [ ] Scaling equivalence is not asserted for incompatible activations such as arbitrary tanh rescaling.
- [ ] Alignment success without causal intervention/retained utility is not called circuit grafting.

work.body:
Roadmap tracker: #1. Research review: November 8, 2026. Priority: **P2 gated research**. This issue proposes work; it records no completed experiment.

## Problem and current boundary

Changing answers or suppressing a forget fact does not establish information erasure or robustness after deployment transformations.

- [docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md](https://github.com/shyamsridhar123/weight-space-programming-framework/blob/main/docs/weight-space/v2/limitations-and-next-steps.md): Unlearning is a future hypothesis with no current live/model erasure evidence.

## Hypothesis and scope

A controlled synthetic study can reveal what bounded forgetting evidence is achievable without a production privacy promise.

## Deliverables

- [ ] Use TOFU-style synthetic identities/forget data and a retain-only trained reference; freeze MUSE-inspired memorization, knowledge, privacy, utility, scale and repeated-request endpoints.
- [ ] Declare attacker knowledge, prompts/queries, extraction scoring, transform/quantization versions, relearning/recovery data and compute budgets.
- [ ] Keep blinded recovery/extraction attacks apart from edit optimization and selection; compare suppression/refusal, applicable fitting/editing controls and retain-only reference.
- [ ] Evaluate full-precision and deployed transforms, repeated edits and retained utility; retain attack failures, missingness and all attempts.

## Acceptance and falsification

- [ ] A passed answer-suppression metric cannot be reported as erasure; residual accessibility, utility and privacy endpoints remain separate.
- [ ] Forgetting survives the declared bounded attack/transform family at frozen criteria, or the robustness claim is rejected.
- [ ] Audit signals used in optimization are disclosed and independently stress-tested; a lower audit score alone is not robust forgetting.
- [ ] All public data are synthetic/public with pinned licenses; no live confidential-data experiment or universal erasure claim is implied.
